decision.explanation: The only register-related evidence is the central beneficial-ownership register entry (D-8I0D0, issued 2027-09-24, so it is within the 30-day freshness window), which names Holgra Ulmunran as sole beneficial owner with 100%, last updated 2025-04-23. The register cannot be verified against itself (R2). The only other document, the internal customer risk record (D-9HQUQ, tier 1 as our own record, rated standard, no alerts), does not identify any beneficial owners, so it cannot confirm or contradict the register. No tier 1 or 2 document other than the register entry states who the beneficial owners are, so no discrepancy determination can be made. Reporting to the register, or requesting a correction, would be unsupported. The required step is to obtain a tier 1 or 2 document identifying the beneficial owners, such as a current business-register shareholder excerpt or a notarial deed for Kasquilkahol B.V., and then re-run the comparison.

The central register entry (D-8I0D0, issued 2027-09-24, so current under R3) names Holgra Ulmunran (DOB 1990-04-15) as sole 100% beneficial owner. The customer's self-declaration (D-NFD2P, tier 3) names a different person, Fenze Venpordor (DOB 1958-10-08), as 100% owner. The internal risk record (D-9HQUQ, standard rating, no alerts) contains no beneficial-ownership information. No tier 1 or 2 document other than the register itself identifies the beneficial owners, so under R2 I cannot confirm or contradict the register and cannot determine whether a discrepancy exists. Reporting to the register or requesting a correction would be premature, and the exception under (a) or (b) cannot be applied without an independent reliable source. The required step is to obtain a tier 1 or 2 document that identifies the beneficial owners, such as a business-register shareholder excerpt or a notarial deed, and to obtain the customer's clarification of the conflicting self-declaration. Once that evidence is in, the discrepancy determination can be made. If the customer cannot provide it, escalate.
